scope: Direct export of the existing complete judgment-study format from feature review; raw feature-review export and all core/scoring/source/event schemas unchanged.

baseline.expectedFailure: Feature review must offer a direct complete-judgment export
baseline.observed: Actual maintained feature page had no direct-export button.

groups: actual feature review, trial selection and resume preserve complete judgments, source, plan, actions and prior help
recorded judgment blocks coordinate, SVG pointer and keyboard edits; the direct feature export reopens the exact study with its placement lock
commit and next sheet preserve old judgments while allowing real coordinate, pointer and keyboard placements
failed raw, review and comparison replacements preserve the companion; feature export retains its existing raw schema
successful explicit raw and saved-feature imports clear old judgments even when their rehearsal bytes match
explicit fresh start and successful comparison replacement cannot inherit earlier judgments
legacy raw handoff and subsequent actual navigation remain compatible
a cancelled fresh navigation leaves accepted judgments available for a subsequent real resume
invalid full judgment history is refused without raw fallback or consuming the recoverable handoff

specificChecks.populatedCanonicalUtf8: Actual download text exactly equals JSON.stringify(original complete study).
specificChecks.reopen: The completed feature-page download reopens through the existing rehearsal importer with exact study/history and placement lock.
specificChecks.availability: Valid empty companion enables export; raw legacy/no companion disables it. Each successful same-history replacement disables it; failed imports preserve it.
specificChecks.selection: Direct export preserves selected trial 2 and does not rewrite the study.
specificChecks.cancellation: Cancelled Fresh preserves button availability and exact study through actual Resume. The common validated handler is unchanged; no separate fourth direct download was added for cancellation.
specificChecks.rawReview: Existing exact feature-review keys, schema and rehearsal remain unchanged.
specificChecks.viewport: Enabled control label and bounds checked at390px; desktop/390px screenshots inspected separately.

review.source: Retained recovery_review independently reviewed the five literal production changes and accepted candidate evidence.
review.validation: Retained validation independently assessed the brokered course and receiving coverage.
review.execution: Lead executed browser tests; independent execution by reviewers is not claimed.

integration: This record covers the candidate. Full package/maintained-launch receiving and actual merged-tree correspondence are recorded with the PR and live estate task.
qualification: Authored geometric browser interaction and portable study behavior; no measured physical performance or learning-effect claim.
